title: O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Results
summary: O’Reilly Automotive, Inc., a leading retailer in the automotive aftermarket industry, has announced record revenue and earnings for its fourth quarter and full-year ended December 31, 2025.
body_markdown:
# O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Results


by[Sonya Cox](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/author/scox35/)


| Feb 5, 2026


|[Content](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/content/) ,[Highlighted Story](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/highlighted-story/) ,[Top News](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/top-news/)


O’Reilly has posted its fourth quarter and full-year earnings. The results represent 33 consecutive years of comparable store sales growth and record revenue and operating income for O’Reilly since becoming a public company in April 1993.


To see the full financial news release, please click[here](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/2026/02/04/oreilly-automotive-inc-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/) .
